components.css: .ds-services { margin: 0; background: var(--color-paper, #fbf8f5); font-family: var(--font-body, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.7; } .ds-service-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.75rem 10%; padding-block: 2rem; border-block-start: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #d8c9ce); } .ds-service-row:last-child { border-block-end: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #d8c9ce); } .ds-service-row > * { min-width: 0; } .ds-service-row dt { color: var(--color-plum, #462238); font-family: var(--font-display, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.25rem); line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-wrap: balance; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-service-row dd { margin: 0; max-width: 54ch; color: var(--color-muted, #6b5662); } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-service-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding-block: 1.6rem; } .ds-service-row dd { max-width: 65ch; } }

narrative.overview:
Quiet serif headings, readable system sans-serif copy, open rows and generous space give this small boutique page a personal, restrained character. Paper is the base; rose and plum create flat section changes.

This records the actual [static page](site/index.html) and [stylesheet](site/styles.css), following the settled [direction contract](docs/landing-page-direction.md). It is a **LOCAL DRAFT**, not an approved V4 brand specification. Earlier V4 assets and exact values were not supplied. The palette, plain text wordmark and local system fonts are deliberate temporary decisions. The finish review returned "ship — LOCAL DRAFT scope"; no public deployment is represented here.
keyCharacteristics: Serif display type paired with system sans-serif body copy.
Restrained asymmetric columns that become one reading column on phones.
Flat color bands, fine rules and direct contact links.
dos: Do preserve the documented provisional palette and font stacks when extending this local draft.
Do keep open rows, readable line lengths, wrapping contact details and visible keyboard focus.
Do update these extracted tokens and the sidecar together when the implementation changes.
donts: Don't describe this draft as approved V4 branding or a public release.
Don't invent a logo, brand font or imagery to fill the missing approved assets.
Don't add card, input or animation patterns to this reference unless they exist in the page.
